2026年暴雪嘉年华（BlizzCon 2026）即将开幕，我们将全程报道开幕式上的所有公告。
这家拥有 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft、星际争霸、暗黑破坏岛 和 Overwatch 的公司准备举办一场比以往任何一届暴雪嘉年华都更受瞩目的开幕式。活动将于太平洋时间上午10:30 / 东部时间下午1:30 / 英国时间下午6:30开始，我们将从主舞台发回现场报道。

那么，我们可以期待什么呢？暴雪已确认，暴雪娱乐总裁 Johanna Faries 将与暴雪旗下所有系列的负责人一同出席开幕式，并发布“重大游戏公告”。最大的期待是暴雪会发布与 星际争霸 相关的内容，此前 星际争霸 官方网站上出现了奇怪的故障。这一明显的预热让这款著名的科幻即时战略系列的粉丝们兴奋不已，尤其是此前有报道称暴雪正在开发一款某种形式的 星际争霸 第一人称射击游戏。

World of 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft 的下一个重大资料片是 World of 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft: The Last Titan，它是继最近发布的 World of 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft: Midnight 之后，作为“世界之魂战记”的最终章。暴雪是会预告 World of 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft: The Last Titan，还是会更多地关注 World of 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft: Midnight 的后续内容？
预计 暗黑破坏岛 将在开幕式上大放异彩。暴雪表示，暗黑破坏岛 将“占据舞台中心，揭晓庇护之地辉煌未来的宏大计划”。我们是否能看到 暗黑破坏岛 4 新资料片或新职业的预告？
与此同时，Overwatch 的粉丝们正期待着新英雄的消息，因为暴雪今年计划发布10位新英雄的目标尚未完成。
此次发布会时长达75分钟，内容非常充实，足以让粉丝们感到兴奋。作为暴雪游戏的忠实粉丝，尤其是 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft 和 暗黑破坏岛，我非常希望能看到这两个系列的重大新闻。开幕式后还将举行开发者更新研讨会，资深玩家可以借此深入了解更多细节。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/zdOHGobuclqffep.png
《无主之地4》在 Steam 排行榜上攀升，玩家们正疯狂迷恋其新的 DLC 角色——一位名叫“黑客 Loveless”的秘藏猎人。

Gearbox Software 的最新作《无主之地4》在 2025 年 9 月发布后的几个月里表现挣扎。尽管创下了该掠夺射击系列史上规模最大的首发纪录，但 PC 和主机平台的技术问题，以及 Gearbox 对局势的处理，导致玩家数量随即急剧下降。SteamDB 的数据显示，自今年 1 月以来，其同时在线玩家数一直难以突破 1 万名。
虽然《无主之地4》在发布时获得了普遍好评，但直到现在才重新激起玩家的兴趣。9 月 10 日周五，拥有高端控制论装备的 DLC 角色“黑客 Loveless”正式发布。她只是更宏大的 Story Pack 2 发布内容的一小部分，但她似乎为游戏带来了第二次生命。
“Loveless 体内存在着两个意识，形成了一套同步的致命技能，如同一体般发起攻击，”Loveless 的描述中写道，“通过生物与数字的共生融合，这位前 Anshin 黑客转型的刺客已进化为更高级的生命形式。装备着最高端的控制论插件，Loveless 与她亲手创造的数字病毒共享精神，该病毒可以数码构造成物理形态的‘龙兽（Wyrm）’，作为她追求完美的共同意志的致命延伸。”
截至本文发表时，《无主之地4》仅在 Steam 平台上就拥有约 26,000 名同时在线玩家。这是自 2025 年 11 月以来的最高值，远高于 3 月份 Story Pack 1 发布时达到的 17,000 名玩家峰值。基础游戏目前也成功跻身美国 Steam 销量排行榜前 5 名，在全球前 10 名榜单中位列第 9。
玩家人数似乎还在进一步攀升，Steam 评论区的玩家特别提到 Loveless 是他们决定重返 Kairos 星球的原因。许多人指出女演员 Carin Gilfry 的配音是一个亮点，但你大概也能猜到其他人的评价。
“单纯为了 Loveless 买的这款游戏，”一条评论写道，“这才是营销之道。”
“实际上是个不错的角色，”一条热门评论说道，“外观漂亮，设计出色，而且强得离谱（可以独自挑战 Boss）。但她的可选头部外观有点……一般。而且她售价 9.99 美元。不过配音演员确实很卖力。总的来说，我觉得她很合适。”
“允许我在不购买 DLC 故事包的情况下单独购买秘藏猎人是正确的决定，”另一位粉丝表示，他指的是 Loveless 10 美元的售价，而与之相对的是最近发布的 Story Pack 2 扩展包。“很高兴他们吸取了教训。另外，妈妈踩我。”
《无主之地4》在 Steam 上玩家激增是由多种因素促成的。除了 Loveless 作为一个受欢迎的新内容外，Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort 也起到了推动作用。此外，Gearbox 正在进行 5 折促销，在截止到 9 月 14 日的免费试玩周末期间，价格降至 34.99 美元。
目前尚不清楚这些数字是否能维持下去，但对《无主之地4》来说，这似乎是一个大获全胜的周末。欲了解更多信息，您可以阅读母公司 Take-Two 对进入市场第二年的 Gearbox 最新作的评价。您还可以阅读有关 Saber 如何挖苦 Gearbox 首席执行官 Randy Pitchford 的内容。

items.title: 《红色管弦乐队2:斯大林格勒英雄 风起云涌》时隔六年迎来首位新英雄

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/fSDnHPbuclqfcdE.png
暴雪旗下的旗舰级 MOBA 游戏 红色管弦乐队2:斯大林格勒英雄 风起云涌 终于展现出了生机。
在 2026 年暴雪嘉年华上宣布，该游戏将迎来继 2020 年霍格发布后的首个新英雄，以及全新的 PTR 测试服。
作为 小小魔兽 资料片 Midnight 的主要反派，萨拉塔斯将于 9 月 28 日星期一降临时空枢纽。PTR 测试将于 9 月 14 日星期一开始。
这对于 红色管弦乐队2:斯大林格勒英雄 风起云涌 的粉丝来说是一个令人欣喜的惊喜，他们此前几乎已经接受了游戏可能永远不会再更新的现实。暴雪在 2022 年停止了对该作的官方支持，并解释称“未来的补丁将主要集中在客户端稳定性和漏洞修复上，平衡性更新将根据需要进行”。
然而，该作在 2023 年获得了一个重大补丁，此后的几年里，零星的小改动和新皮肤也陆续推出。粉丝们现在比以往任何时候都更有希望，暴雪也是如此——但未来的更新完全取决于社区对这次“新鲜血液”的反应。
暴雪的一位系列负责人在接受媒体采访时表示，公司将“观察这次的表现”，并透露“如果社区反应良好，可能会带来更多内容”，并将此次更新描述为“迈向重大目标的第一次尝试”。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/yLPiwfbuclqeEdx.png
距离暴雪备受喜爱的即时战略游戏 星际争霸2:自由之翼 问世已经过去了 15 年多。现在，该系列的一款新作已经正式公布——但距离发售还有数年之久。

事实上，这是一个完全不同的游戏类型。星际争霸 是一款开放世界射击游戏，预计将于 2030 年发售。虽然如此遥远的发售窗口让人很难立即对 星际争霸 感到兴奋，但暴雪在游戏准备好面向公众之前很久就公布游戏的做法早有先例。事实上，这家开发了 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft、暗黑破坏岛 和 Overwatch 的公司在这方面“声名在外”，历史上一直信奉着这样一条准则：“准备好时自然会发布（It’ll be ready when it’s ready）。”
在 星际争霸 官方网站出现大量视觉“故障”并发布“警告”称用户设备已“受损”后，人们就预料到暴雪嘉年华上会公布 星际争霸 系列新作。粉丝们认为这意味着该系列即将迎来重大更新，事实证明他们是对的。
事实上，有关 星际争霸 射击游戏的传闻已经流传多年。2024 年，彭博社记者 Jason Schreier 透露了暴雪正尝试第三次开发 星际争霸 射击游戏的消息，由 2022 年加入暴雪的前 孤岛惊魂：新的曙光 执行制作人 Dan Hay 负责领导。随后在 2024 年晚些时候，一份针对“即将推出的开放世界射击游戏”的招聘信息发布，粉丝们确信这与这款 星际争霸 游戏有关。
多年来，暴雪在开发 星际争霸 射击游戏方面历经坎坷。2002 年公布的 星际争霸 Ghost 原本是一款战术动作主机游戏，玩家在其中扮演受雇于泰伦帝国的致命幽灵特工，但在经历了一系列跳票后，该项目于 2006 年被取消。
第二次尝试开发 星际争霸 射击游戏的代号为 阿瑞斯：守护者崛起，但该项目在 2019 年被取消，以便暴雪能专注于 暗黑破坏岛 4 和 Overwatch 2。据报道，阿瑞斯：守护者崛起 “就像是 星际争霸 宇宙版的 《Battlefield 3™》”，但和 星际争霸 Ghost 一样，最终半途而废。
现在，随着这款正在开发的新 星际争霸 射击游戏的出现，暴雪或许能迎来“事不过三”的好运。

新英雄名为 Doctrine，是一位吸血鬼支援英雄，他拥有极高的操作下限，能够输出大量伤害并提供高额治疗。随之而来的是一张全新的可玩运载目标地图——格里姆斯沃恩监测站（Watch Point Grimsvotn），这是一座关押他的火山监狱。此外，从今天（9 月 12 日）开始，无论是在暴雪嘉年华现场还是在家中，玩家都可以在试玩周末体验这位英雄。
其他重大消息方面，Overwatch Season 5 将于 10 月 6 日开启。Dokiwatch 也将回归，并且计划进行一些重大的英雄重做：据暴雪系列负责人称，路霸将被重做为一个“真正能帮助团队”的重装英雄，而黑影则将转为支援位。

items.title: Level-5社长回应游戏发布会后的AI争议

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/TQuGFpbucljkiti.png
开发商 Level-5 就其使用生成式人工智能（AI）的行为进行了道歉和说明，此前粉丝在 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village、DecaPolice 等游戏的画面中发现了“AI 废料”。
雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产
益智, 解谜, 冒险

在本周早些时候该工作室举行了类似任天堂直面会风格的发布会后，担忧开始浮现。这场名为“Level5 Vision 2026 II: Dreams”的发布会展示了即将推出的新作，但也出现了粉丝怀疑是生成式 AI 的多个案例。
观看这场 50 分钟发布会的观众花在讨论疑似 AI 使用证据上的时间，比讨论游戏本身的时间还多，比如 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 重制版、妖怪手表破坏者：赤猫团 2: Haunted Domain 和 DecaPolice。引起争议的画面大多局限于背景场景，但粉丝们不得不质疑 Level-5 这一事实，已使这一局面演变成这家总部位于日本的工作室的全面争议。
妖怪手表破坏者：赤猫团
幻想, 角色扮演
查看更多 立即下载
“噢不，Level-5 绝对是在使用生成式 AI 来‘更新’ 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产。尤其是将原版背景与新背景对比时。增加了这么多奇怪的细节和不一致之处。”
“在 Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain 的新预告片中，景太的……脸变了？！😭 上图为昨天（左）/ 今天（右）”
“当 Level-5 宣布带着 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产、DecaPolice、妖怪手表破坏者：赤猫团 等作品强势回归时，我非常兴奋，”一位社交媒体用户表示。“但看到这么多明目张胆的生成式 AI 被应用在他们的游戏中……是的，这不对劲。”
“你们曾是一家出色的工作室，”另一位粉丝说道。“现在你们对我们来说不过是令人失望。我们不想要这些 AI 垃圾。”
Level-5 社长兼 CEO 日野晃博也以自己的动画形象主持了这场发布会，他在社交平台上发文安抚舆论。他的信息既是道歉也是解释，确认了 Level-5 确实在开发的某些方面使用了生成式 AI。
日野将 Level-5 大量使用 AI 描述为“对最新技术的实验”，并补充说团队“向任何对此感到不适的人表示诚挚的歉意”。
“我原本对 DecaPolice 很感兴趣，但 Level-5 使用 AI 的行为让我感到恶心。我无法支持这一点。”
“但是，请放心，定义我们已发布作品魅力和个性的所有元素——如剧本、角色设计和基础设定——完全是由人手创作的，”日野表示。“我们主要利用 AI 来简化人造资产的数字化过程；例如，将原始艺术稿准确转换为 3D 多边形模型。您可以放心，我们发行的游戏不包含纯粹由 AI 生成的内容。”
日野还为 Level-5 目前使用 AI 的方式辩护，称：“通过 AI 驱动的效率提升所节省的时间，让我们的创作者能够将更多精力投入到真正的创意核心中。”对于他和团队其他成员来说，他们相信 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village 等游戏的最终版本最终仍会令粉丝满意。这次如此依赖生成式 AI 的部分原因是希望能将“大作的开发周期从目前的五年缩短到两年”。
“尽管如此，我们不能否认这次广泛使用了 AI，这是出于希望呈现一个视觉冲击力强且易于理解的演示文档的渴望，”他继续说道。“我们将把这次经历作为未来的学习机会，所以请期待 Level-5 的下一次发布会。”
这一解释在 Level-5 社区反响不佳。帖子的回复中，粉丝们仍对开发过程中使用生成技术感到担忧，担心受影响的游戏将永远留下污点。
“生成式 AI 是科技公司利用无数艺术家被盗的作品进行训练以谋取利益的，其目的是取代艺术家，”一条热门回复称。“通过使用它，你们取代了艺术家。你们正在利用那些为了驱动该软件而被盗用的艺术家的技能获利。”
“我相信人心比上市速度更重要；不使用 AI 耗时五年肯定更好，”另一条日文帖子写道。“如果哪怕只有一个资产是用 AI 创建的，‘这个图像、这段音乐或这段对话是 AI 还是人类创作的？’这种挥之不去的担忧就永远不会消失。维护这种信任难道不是最重要的吗？”
日野没有就 Level-5 未来将如何调整开发计划提供具体的方案。目前，2007 年原版游戏的重制版 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village 计划于 2027 年登陆 PC 和主机。该系列的另一款新作 the New World of Steam 将于今年 12 月发售。

items.title: WoW Forever Will Add All-New Content To Classic Azeroth This November
items.summary: World of Warcraft Forever is Blizzard's next iteration on WoW Classic, one that will add new content in the fo

content.v: World of Warcraft Forever is Blizzard's next iteration on WoW Classic, one that will add new content in the form of zones, quests, dungeons, raids, and even a new playable race while keeping the old-school MMORPG's world and gameplay intact.

Revealed during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , WoW Forever is Blizzard's attempt to give WoW Classic fans the "forever" game they've wanted for years. However, instead of the MMO progressing to the game's subsequent expansions and their new areas, as Classic has in the past, WoW Forever will instead keep the focus on WoW's original two continents, Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.

Within that Classic backdrop will be up to 1,000 new quests, Blizzard said, as well as revamped zones, and three entirely new zones that fill out areas present on the map in vanilla WoW but were never accessible to players. There will be nine new dungeons to explore, two raids, and an additional PvP battleground. A new playable race is also part of the package: the Skyborne elves. One of the new playable zones will be their starting area, Blizzard said.

In addition to all-new content, Blizzard will be revamping classes with new talents and skills, as well as allowing for new class and race combinations. An option to toggle HD visuals and old-school graphics will also be included. Blizzard will continue to update WoW Forever with new content, but won't raise the level cap past 60.

Unlike modern WoW, WoW Forever won't be focused on the endgame experience. Blizzard said many of the new dungeons and quests will be for characters under level 60. That aligns with what Blizzard said were its core principles in how it approached development of WoW Forever--that it should be about the journey, not the destination; the world itself is a character; and the game's social aspects should be a focus.
For those who want to continue experiencing the original version of Azeroth, the normal version of WoW Classic will still be playable.
Players won't have to wait long to experience this new version of Azeroth themselves. A playable beta will go live September 17, with the full version of WoW Forever launching November 4.

items.summary: It's out soon, too, with a beta starting this week.

content.v: The rumored game known to World of Warcraft fans as "Classic Plus" is real, and it has a proper name now—World of Warcraft: Forever is a new branch of the MMO that once again resets the clock to 2004, the year WoW first launched.

But unlike WoW: Classic, the goal of WoW: Forever isn't just to take a trip back to the MMO's origins to relive those heady early years. WoW: Forever will explore new parts of Azeroth, telling stories that weren't told during the MMO's original progression.
PC Gamer was briefed on the announcement before the reveal at the BlizzCon Opening Ceremony. Here are the biggest takeaways:

It's a strategy reminiscent of Old School RuneScape, which treats the 2006 version of the MMO as a jumping-off point rather than a specimen to be preserved. It's worked out well for Jagex: OSRS is bigger now than it was during the original run.

The existence of three different Worlds of Warcraft might risk diluting the playerbase, but if any MMO is big enough to sustain three official forks—and if any studio has the resources to support them—it's probably WoW and Blizzard.

WoW: Forever will be playable at BlizzCon this weekend, and a beta starts this Thursday. The full launch isn't far away either: Forever is set to release on November 4. World of Warcraft: Forever is covered by the pre-existing WoW subscription, but upgrade packs with features like the Skyborne race are available on Battle.net starting at $30.

Precise details weren't shared during the opening ceremony, but Sombra's going to become a support and Roadhog should be less "frustrating" to deal with.

items.title: Blizzard just dropped a new Warcraft 3 campaign, the first in 23 years
items.summary: The year of the surprise old game expansion.

content.v: For the first time since its Frozen Throne expansion in 2003, Warcraft 3 is getting a new campaign. Or got one, more accurately: Blizzard just announced at BlizzCon that it's dropping the expansion today.

In a pre-brief before BlizzCon's opening ceremony, we learned that Warcraft 3: Forsaken Kingdom is a two-part campaign for Warcraft 3: Reforged, the 2020 remaster of the 2002 RTS. It begins with a prologue covering the story of Arthas, the primary antagonist in World of Warcraft's Wrath of the Lich King expansion.
The main portion of the campaign following that prologue regards the Undercity, the capital of the undead Forsaken Kingdom, where we'll find the likes of Sylvanas, Putress, and the Scarlet Crusade.
Alongside the new expansion, Warcraft 3 Reforged is getting a free 3.0 update. Forsaken Kingdom is available now for $30 on Battle.net .

Reforged was not a popular remaster of Warcraft 3 when it first launched in 2020, but a new update and surprise expansion could go a long way toward rehabilitating the project. 2026 is now firmly the year of the surprise expansion to an old game: Forsaken Kingdom joins Thief Remastered: The Tarnished Mirror , Quake: Dawn of the Machine , and The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in this strange new category.

content.v: As is BlizzCon tradition, a new World of Warcraft cinematic premiered during the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony , setting the stage for the MMORPG's next expansion, The Last Titan.

In a departure for BlizzCon, that glimpse was just about all fans learned about the new expansion, with Blizzard instead looking to put the focus more on the final content patch of the game's current Midnight expansion.

That update, titled Eclipse, will consist of a climactic showdown with the franchise's current main villain, Xal'atath. An in-game cinematic shown during the ceremony revealed Xal'atath's true objective, to merge with Azeroth's worldsoul and become unstoppable.
Blizzard additionally teased a new standalone game mode, and yet another expansion Remix experience, will also be coming to Midnight before the expansion's end.

As for The Last Titan's setting, it takes players back to Northrend, the continent previously seen in 2008's Wrath of the Lich King expansion. Much like how Blizzard revamped Silvermoon City and the Blood Elf lands of Quel'thalas in Midnight to great results, Northrend will be completely rebuilt from the ground up. Blizzard said more details about The Last Titan will be shared next year.

The Last Titan was first announced at BlizzCon 2023, when Blizzard made the unprecedented move of announcing an entire trilogy of expansions all at once. Collectively, Blizzard called the three expansions The Worldsoul Saga, with a goal of bringing together many of WoW's disparate storylines from over the last 20 years into one fitting conclusion.

As the end of the trilogy, The Last Titan has a lot of expectations to live up to that the main storyline of WoW's two previous expansions, The War Within and Midnight, haven't exactly met. Regardless, it will still be exciting to see how Blizzard ties two decades' worth of story involving the Void, the Titans, and Azeroth herself together into one cohesive package.

content.v: At today's Blizzcon opening ceremony, it was announced that Hearthstone will receive a third post-launch class—the game's first since the Death Knight released in 2022. It's none other than the Monk, a class with origins you can trace all the way back to Warcraft 3's pandaren brewmaster.

Represented by the playable Chen Stormstout, the Monk will get a full reveal next year. While not World of Warcraft's most popular class, it is perhaps its silliest, which fits Hearthstone's cartoonish sensibilities to a T. After this point, the Evoker will be the only class from Blizzard's titan MMO that isn't represented in card game form (unless you count the Night Elf Mohawk ).

The expansion coming in the meantime, Reign of the Black Empire, is another old god-themed extravaganza, complete with bouncy electronic grooves all over the trailer. No goofy lyrics this time around, but what can you do?
It also comes with a new keyword, "assemble," which allows players to merge cards for ludicrous combos. It sounds like the sort of shenanigan-magnet Hearthstone is known for.
Reign of the Black Empire will land on Oct. 10, with the Monk class arriving March 2027. Follow the rest of today's Blizzcon news on our liveblog .

items.title: Overwatch Is Reworking Two Of Its Most Criticized Characters
items.summary: After years of complaints, Overwatch is finally reworking two of its veteran heroes. Announced during BlizzCon

content.v: After years of complaints, Overwatch is finally reworking two of its veteran heroes. Announced during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , both Roadhog and Sombra will be receiving major reworks, with Sombra pivoting to being a support hero and Roadhog undergoing changes to make him more of a team player.
Shortly after the reveal, Overwatch shared an updated look at both character's Hero kits. Below is a comprehensive overview of their changes:
Sombra
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-12-at-11.39.45-AM-1.png?w=636

Of the two, Sombra is receiving the most significant redesign, pivoting from a Damage hero to Support. Whereas she used to be most effective at fast-paced, ambush-style combat, she will now be far more useful in team settings. Her Hack ability has been replaced with Hotfix, which allows her to freely hack health packs and enemy deployables as well as heal allies. Cyberspace replaces Virus, and sees Sombra launch a projectile that heals allies and weakens enemies. With the exception of CTRL ALT ESC, all of Sombra's Perks have been adjusted, and she now boasts Support passives.
Roadhog
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-12-at-11.39.35-AM.png?w=636

By comparison Roadhog's changes are far less dramatic, with the most notable being the removal of Scrap Gun's Alt Fire. In lieu of this skill, Roadhog has been given Trash Compactor--an ability that allows Roadhog to absorb enemy projectiles and turn them into an explosive ball of scrap. This makes him far more effective as an actual Tank, granting him what seems like a fairly effective barrier that will hopefully deter players from abandoning their team in search of smaller firefights.
In addition to these changes, Blizzard has announced Overwatch's 54th character, Doctrine , is coming October 5.

items.title: Overwatch’s Newest Blood-Sucking Character Pushes The Game Even Further Into The Fantasy Genre
items.summary: Since its inception, Overwatch has positioned itself as an optimistic, science-fiction-driven world. Although

content.v: Since its inception, Overwatch has positioned itself as an optimistic, science-fiction-driven world. Although some characters have introduced an element of the fantastical--the addition of the magical Wuxing University being the most notable tonal shift--the team behind the hero shooter has always prioritized scientific explanations for its heroes incredible abilities. Its newest character, however, seems to venture further into fantasy than ever before.

Revealed during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , Doctrine is the next support hero coming to Overwatch. Oh and fun fact, he's a vampire--or vampire-inspired, at the very least. With a sceptre that heals and speeds up teammates yet dishes out major damage to enemies, Doctrine is an extremely powerful hero with a high mechanical floor. Interested in putting your skills to the test and giving him a whirl? You're in luck, as Doctrine's limited-time hero trial has officially kicked off and will run until September 14.

In addition to his sceptre, Doctrine can also unleash a swarm of bat drones, infuse allies, and "manipulate life force." Blizzard has described the hero as the "ultimate vampire fantasy." Below is a more thorough look at his Hero kit:
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-12-at-11.32.20-AM.png?w=636

While Doctrine (real name Tamuka Yeukai) hails from Zimbabwe, he is accompanied by the Escort map Watchpoint: Grimsvotn, which depicts the Icelandic prison he is seen escaping in his debut cinematic. Doctrine joins Overwatch on the side of Talon, his trailer revealing him to be a close friend of Doomfist. This relationship also expresses itself mechanically, as the Overwatch team stated his kit complements Doomfist's extremely well.
In other Overwatch news, the team shared that two of its most criticized legacy characters, Sombra and Roadhog, are undergoing major changes .

items.summary: StarCraft Ghost I will never forget you.

others.title: Next StarCraft Game Announced at BlizzCon as an Open-World Shooter, but It’s Not Due Out Until 2030

content.v: The rumors were true: A new StarCraft game is incoming. It's just called "StarCraft," it's an open world shooter, and Blizzard doesn't plan to release it until 2030.
The game was revealed at BlizzCon with a cinematic trailer, but no gameplay was shown, which isn't surprising given how far off it is.

The trailer showcases the training and gearing up of a Terran Dominion Space Marine, with faction leader and Starcraft series baddie Arcturus Mengsk giving an inspirational speech about killing Zerg over the montage. It ends with our anonymous hero doing battle with the Zerg, then a cut to his broken and bloody armor getting cleaned and repaired without him back on a Dominion ship.
So we now know it's set during or before the events of StarCraft 2, with a primary focus on the Space Marine experience.

This isn't the first time Blizzard has attempted an action-forward StarCraft spinoff. StarCraft Ghost was a legendary, Duke Nukem Forever-tier bit of vaporware that Blizzard teased, demoed, and reworked for much of the 2000s. Its titular Ghost, Nova, eventually got the consolation prize of being a secondary character in StarCraft 2 and the protagonist of a few tie-in novels. This new shooter appears to borrow little, if anything, from that earlier effort by Blizzard.

There was some speculation before the show that Blizzard might announce a new StarCraft RTS, but there's no sign of such a project, if it exists. It'll be interesting to see how fans react, as well as the esports scene. Excited for new StarCraft anything? Disappointed that it's not an RTS?

items.title: StarCraft Is Officially Back, But It’s Taking A Much Different Form
items.summary: Following numerous rumors dating back many months, it's official: StarCraft is returning with a new game, but

content.v: Following numerous rumors dating back many months, it's official: StarCraft is returning with a new game, but that game won't be in the traditional real-time-strategy genre the franchise is known for. Instead, the new StarCraft game is described as an open-world shooter.

The news was revealed as part of BlizzCon's opening ceremony . However, that's essentially all we know, as the new game-referred to only as StarCraft--won't be released until 2030. As such, there were no further details shared about how it will play or anything else.

After Blizzard's Dan Hay said, "It's about damn time" that we returned to the interstellar war of StarCraft, we did see a cinematic trailer. Dominion forces are shown being pumped up after being trained as elite warriors. They're then sent onto the battlefield against a massive wave of Zerg forces.

When it does arrive, this will mark the first original game in the StarCraft franchise since the StarCraft II trilogy wrapped up with Legacy of the Void in 2015. The original game did receive a remaster, StarCraft Remastered, in 2017, but Blizzard's focus has otherwise shifted to its other franchises over the last decade.

While a StarCraft shooter had been rumored for some time, the reveal is still sure to come as a contentious piece of news for fans starved for a traditional StarCraft game. (The audible reaction from the crowd when "open-world shooter" was said was not necessarily one of elation.)

This isn't the first attempt to spin off the series into something else, as StarCraft Ghost was meant to be a stealth-action entry, but it was ultimately canceled prior to release. A recent report indicated that Nexon is seeking the StarCraft license in order to make a new game--possibly StarCraft III--so there may still be some hope for another StarCraft RTS.

Teases for a StarCraft revival began earlier this month, after the game's official website started to "glitch" and fans discovered hidden text logs. Each one appeared to be a secret transmission hinting at something on the horizon, with rumors circulating that it could be anything from a Helldivers-inspired co-op shooter game to the revival of StarCraft: Ghost.

But the main takeaway is that StarCraft is back, and in a big way. While it wasn't the first successful franchise to emerge from Blizzard, it still remains a key pillar for the company even after years of dormancy. The original StarCraft real-time strategy game and its Brood War expansion were huge hits upon release, and in South Korea, local internet cafes became hubs for competitive PvP that laid the groundwork for the rise of esports.

content.v: It's rare that a MOBA comes out, rarer that it manages to stick around, and perhaps rarest of all that it surges back to life after years on the backburner. While Heroes of the Storm never quite had its lights turned off , the constant downpour of new stuff you'd expect in a live service game did wind down. Until now.

At today's Blizzcon opening ceremony, it was announced that Xal'atath, the Harbinger of the Void, will be arriving in the long-dormant MOBA as a new hero—its first since Hogger was released all the way back in 2020. It's the first truly substantial update since 2022, as the game has only received light-touch balance passes and bug fixes since Blizzard announced a shift to maintenance mode.

If you're unfamiliar, Xal'atath is a character from World of Warcraft's Legion expansion who started as a gnawing voice tucked away in the weapon slots of Shadow Priest players. More recently, she's become the villainous face of the current Midnight expansion.
It was also announced that another new hero would be revealed at some point in the future.
Xal'atath will arrive on the game's PTR this Monday, with a full release scheduled for Sep. 28. Follow the rest of today's Blizzcon news on our liveblog .

But as WoW's long-running storylines are moving toward a conclusion that involves Xal'atath, that character is set to be added to HotS, and she arrives quite soon.

Blizzard revealed the new addition as part of the BlizzCon Opening Ceremony . Xal'atath will join the Public Test Realm beginning this Monday, September 14, with a full release set for September 28. This will mark the first new character since Warcraft's Hogger was added in 2020.

items.title: Borderlands 4 DLC Character and Free-to-Play Weekend Attract Resurgence on Steam
items.summary: Borderlands 4 is climbing Steam charts as players fall head over heels for its new DLC character – a Vault Hun

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/borderlands-4-loveless-1789234281945.png
Borderlands 4 is climbing Steam charts as players fall head over heels for its new DLC character – a Vault Hunter named Loveless the Hacker.

Gearbox Software's latest Borderlands game struggled in the months following its September 2025 launch. Despite delivering the looter shooter series' biggest launch ever , technical issues across PC and console , as well as Gearbox's handling of the situation , were immediately followed by a steep decline in players, with SteamDB recording numbers that have struggled to break 10,000 concurrent users since January of this year.

Borderlands 4 might have launched to generally favorable reviews (IGN gave it an 8/10 ), but it's struggled to recapture player interest – until now. Thursday, September 10, saw the release of Loveless the Hacker, a DLC character with high-end cybernetics. She's only a small part of a grander Story Pack 2 release, and she seems to be giving the game a second wind.

"Two minds exist inside Loveless, forming a synchronized set of lethal skills that strike as one," a description for Loveless says. "Through a symbiotic melding of the biological and digital, this ex-Anshin hacker-turned-assassin has become a superior lifeform. Equipped with the highest-end cybernetics, Loveless shares her psyche with a digital virus of her own creation, which can digistruct into a physical Wyrm form to act as a deadly extension of her shared, perfection-seeking will."

At the time of this story's publication, Borderlands 4 is enjoying around 26,000 concurrent players on Steam alone. That's the most it's had since November 2025, and far higher than the 17,000-player peak it reached with the launch of Story Pack 1 in March. The base game has also now managed to round out the Top 5 sellers on Steam in the U.S., and it's even come in at nine in the Top 10 global list.

Player counts also appear to be climbing even further, with those in its Steam reviews section specifically calling attention to Loveless as the reason they've decided to return to the planet Kairos. Many refer to voice acting from actress Carin Gilfry as a specific positive, but you can probably guess what a lot of the others had to say.
"Bought the game solely because of Loveless," one review said . "This is how you market."
Bro she’s so bad Loveless? But girl I LOVE YOU pic.twitter.com/ASqXkrZhhX

"Actually a nice character," a popular review said . "Looks good, good design, is insanely OP (can solo bosses without any help). But her alternate heads are a bit -- meh. And she costs $9.99. The VA put some effort into it though. Overall – I think she fits."

"Letting me buy the Vault Hunter without having to by the DLC story pack is the correct call," another fan said , referencing Loveless' $10 asking price compared to the recently released Story Pack 2 expansion. "Glad they learned. Also, step on me Mommy."

There are a number of factors contributing to Borderlands 4's boost in players on Steam, specifically. In addition to Loveless' status as a popular addition, Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort has also helped. There's also the fact that Gearbox is in the middle of a 50% off sale, bringing its price to $34.99 in the midst of a free-to-play weekend that runs until September 14.

It's unclear if the numbers will stick, but it seems to be a winning weekend for Borderlands 4 nonetheless. For more, you can read about what parent company Take-Two had to say about Gearbox's latest as it heads into its second year on the market . You can also read about how Saber took a dig at Gearbox CEO Randy Pitchford .

Doctrine's Hero Trial will be available for all Overwatch players later today.
Overwatch’s Newest Blood-Sucking Character Pushes The Game Even Further Into The Fantasy Genre
Big Overwatch changes are on the horizon
Sombra and Roadhog are getting some big reworks in Overwatch soon. Sombra is being turned into a Support-class hero, and a whole lot of content is planned for Season 5 of the game.
Overwatch Is Reworking Two Of Its Most Criticized Characters
A familiar face is coming to Diablo 4

Stay a while, and listen to what's next for Diablo! Tiffany Wat and Brent Gibson from the Diablo team announced that everyone's favorite Horadrim scholar, Deckard Cain, will return to Sanctuary soon. You can meet the fan-favorite character in Diablo 4 on September 15, when Season of Hell's Legacy launches.
Hell's Pawn is crossing over to Diablo Immortal
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Diablo-Spawn.jpg?w=636
Todd McFarlane's Spawn is coming to Diablo Immortal, which makes my inner '90s kid very happy. Honestly, could you ask for a better crossover character in the free-to-play mobile game?
Diablo 4 lands on Switch 2 in September
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Diablo-4-Switch-2.jpg?w=636
And it'll be out on September 15! Switch 2 owners can grab Diablo 4: Age of Hatred Collection when it launches alongside the new Season of Hell's Legacy.
The Amazon is coming to Diablo 4
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Diablo-4-Amazon.jpg?w=636

At long last, you can play as an Amazon in Diablo 4. This new take on the fan-favorite character will wield her signature bow, as well as the new javelin-class weapon. She'll be added to the game in the first half of 2027.
Diablo 4’s Next Class Is What You Expect But Isn’t Coming With A Full Expansion
Diablo 5 launches in 2029

With the Age of Hatred having concluded in Diablo 4, it's time for the next chapter in the series. Diablo 5 is currently scheduled to launch in Spring 2029, and things look bleak . In Diablo 5, the ancient Lord of Terror has returned and has conquered Sanctuary.
"What must you become, when the world has already fallen?" Wat teased for the dark direction of Diablo 5.
Diablo 5 Is Coming In 2029, Will Actually Star Diablo
Hearthstone's next expansion launches in October

What's next for Hearthstone? A new expansion and a new gameplay mechanic while you explore a narrative focused on the brawls between Old Gods that shaped the world of Azeroth. The new Assemble mechanic will allow you to fuse two cards together, and the Hearthstone team says that it's well aware that there'll be some "pretty busted" combinations. A pool of 250 cards can make use of this mechanic, and some of the combinations shown off are wild. You can try it out for yourself when Reign of the Black Empire launches on October 20.
Hearthstone's new hero is panda-ring to the Warcraft crowd
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Monk_8ae7c7.jpg?w=636
That's right, the Monk class is finally coming to Hearthstone, marking the first new class in four years.
Hearthstone’s First New Class In 4 Years And A More Story-Driven Journal Are On The Way
World of Warcraft: Midnight - Eclipse

World of Warcraft's Holly Longdale and Ion Hazzikostas introduced a new chapter in World of Warcraft's Worldsoul Saga, teasing "all gas and no brakes" in the new major content update. Eclipse will set the stage for a showdown with Xal'atath, and the new cinematic trailer showed her on the verge of a serious power-up.
World of Warcraft: The Last Titan

While Eclipse is the next big narrative chapter in World of Warcraft, The Last Titan is where Blizzard is promising a big shake-up to the MMORPG as it wraps up 20 years of storytelling. More details on it will be shared next year.
WoW: The Last Titan Cinematic Ups The Stakes, But First, Xal’atath
Warcraft 3 is getting a new campaign

Longdale teased that Blizzard is "putting the war back in Warcraft" with the new campaign, Forsaken Kingdom, for Warcraft 3: Reforged. When can you play it? Today! Players will get to experience the fall of Lodaeron as Human armies took on mighty Orc forces. Other enhancements include a Definitive Edition graphical update, map editor improvements, and you can even select more units to command.
Warcraft Getting Its First New RTS Campaign In Two Decades–And It’s Playable Today
World of Warcraft: Forever

Azeroth is beckoning players back to where it all started, as we got a first look at World of Warcraft: Forever. The rumored Classic Plus mode for World of Warcraft will kick off with a beta on September 17 and launch on November 4. The game will include new dungeons, 10-20 player raids, the Skyborne as a playable race, account-wide perks, and new zones to explore.

items.title: Level-5 Boss Addresses AI Backlash After Fans Hit Out at Game Reveal Showcase
items.summary: Developer Level-5 has apologized for and explained its use of generative AI after fans spotted 'AI slop' in fo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/professor-layton-and-the-new-world-of-steam-1789228310265.png
Developer Level-5 has apologized for and explained its use of generative AI after fans spotted "AI slop" in footage of games like Professor Layton and the Curious Village , DecaPolice, and more.

Concerns emerged following the studio's Nintendo Direct-style presentation earlier this week. Dubbed Level5 Vision 2026 II: Dreams, the show came with first looks at upcoming games, and it also happened to feature what fans suspected to be multiple examples of genAI.

Those who tuned into the 50-minute presentation spent more time talking about what they believed was evidence of AI use rather than the games, such as the Professor Layton remake, Yo-Kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain, and DecaPolice. The footage causing a stir is mostly limited to background scenes, but it's the fact that fans had to question Level-5 in the first place that's turned the situation into a full-fledged controversy for the Japan-based studio.

Oh no Level-5 is DEFINATELY using Gen AI to "update" Professor Layton. Especially when you compare the original backgrounds to the new. So many weird details and inconsistencies were added. https://t.co/AjVNfgetkk pic.twitter.com/0tRQ9vKn03
⁉️ Dans le nouveau trailer de Yo-kai Watch 2 : Haunted Domain, Nathan a… changé de visage ?! 😭 #YOKAIWATCH Hier (gauche) / Aujourd’hui (droite) pic.twitter.com/Vr3rzwNPA7

"I was SO excited when Level-5 announced their big comeback with Professor Layton, Decapolice, Yo-Kai Watch, and more," one fan on X/Twitter said . "But seeing this much blatant genAI being used across their games… yeah, this ain’t it"
"You were a beautiful studio," another fan said . "Now you are nothing more than a disappointment to us. We don’t want this AI s**t."

Level-5 president and CEO Akihiro Hino, who also hosted the showcase with his own animated avatar, took to X/Twitter to calm the noise. His message was both an apology and an explanation, confirming that Level-5 did, in fact, use generative AI for some aspects of development.
Hino described Level-5's heavy use of AI as "experimentation with the latest technology," adding that the team "sincerely apologizes to anyone who found this off-putting."
I was excited about Decapolice but Level-5 AI use is disgusting to me. I can't support that. https://t.co/EpxgBtCnDo

"However, please be assured that all elements defining the appeal and individuality of our released titles— such as the scenario, character designs, and foundational settings — are created entirely by human hands," Hino said (via Google translate). "We utilize AI primarily to streamline the process of digitizing human-created assets; for instance, accurately converting original artwork into 3D polygon models. You can rest assured that the games we release do not contain content simply generated by AI."

Hino also defended how Level-5 has used AI so far, saying: "the time saved through AI-driven efficiencies has allowed our creators to dedicate more of their efforts to the true essence of creativity." For him and the rest of the team, the belief is that the finished versions of games like Professor Layton and the Curious Village will still please fans in the end. Part of the reason it leaned so heavily on genAI this time around was so it could shrink "the development cycle for major titles from the current five years down to two."

"That said, we cannot deny that we made extensive use of AI this time, driven by a desire to deliver a presentation that was visually striking and easy to grasp," he continued. "We will take this experience as a learning opportunity for the future, so please look forward to Level-5’s next presentation."
pic.twitter.com/cict4COGTP

It's an explanation that hasn't gone over well in the Level-5 community. Replies to the post include fans still concerned about generative technology being used during development at all, fearing that affected games will be forever tarnished.

"Generative AI is trained on the stolen works of countless artists by tech companies to profit off their work, with the intent of replacing artists," one popular reply said . "By using it you replaced artists. You're profiting off of the skill of artists whose work has been stolen to power this software."

"I believe the human heart matters more than speed to market; surely it is better to take five years without using AI," another post written in Japanese said (via Google Translate). "If even a single asset is created using AI, the nagging worry — 'Is this image, piece of music, or line of dialogue made by AI or a human?' — would never go away. Isn't preserving that trust the most important thing?"

Hino didn't offer a specific game plan when it comes to how Level-5 will tweak its development plans going forward. For now, Professor Layton and the Curious Village, a remake of the original 2007 game, is slated to come to PC and consoles in 2027 . Another new game in the series, the New World of Steam , is due out this December.
